goal: Prevent dropping well-behaved peers on slow connections when block transfers delay pong responses past 20 minutes
Suspend the ping timeout while a peer has blocks in flight plus a one-minute grace period after
agreement: Strong support with multiple ACKs and no open objections
Verified by testing throttled block downloads without ping timeouts (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Approval alongside suggestions on lock scoping and test assertions (fjahr, maflcko)
Concept approval without detailed review (l0rinc, danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes spurious disconnections of well-behaved peers during block downloads
Benefit is limited to nodes on slow connections where block relay starves ping responses
